title: Sorting by Height (Basic)
description: Entry conveyor feeding a chain transfer that sends boxes left or right by height (high/low diffuse sensors), two exit conveyors with retroreflective eyes, operator panel (Start, Stop, Reset, Emergency stop, Auto), three panel lights and a counter display. Live rig: Factory I/O is the Modbus TCP client of the OpenPLC v4 Modbus server; sensors are coils 100+ (declared AT %QX12.4.. and only read), actuators coils 0+ (%QX0.0..), counter holding register 0 (%QW0). I/O map verified live by Developer 1 (rig handoff, 2026-10-11).
